warnings: Input metadata records capture_source=processed result, with applied_modes=0 for all included images. These files alone do not certify an unmodified raw sensor projection; treat as a trial calibration until the capture path is confirmed.
Calibration uses the OpenCV fisheye theta polynomial k1,k2,k3,k4; these are NOT Brown-Conrady k1,k2,p1,p2,k3 and must not be inserted into the current FPGA model.
All supplied views were used for fitting; leave-one-out checks reuse this capture session and are not an independent validation dataset.

Leave-one-out cy varies from 331.69 to 396.09px; the maximum full-grid rectification change is 92.82px. Low training RMS does not certify stable intrinsics. Additional independent, flat-board views with substantial pitch and edge coverage are recommended before deployment.

stability.definition: Leave-one-out pixel-to-rectified-pixel comparison on a 25x15 full-image grid using the same fixed output K. This measures model sensitivity, not an independently measured error.
